query: SELECT DISTINCT ?item ?label ?links (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?alt;separator="|") AS ?aliases) WHERE { ?item wdt:P31?/wdt:P279* wd:Q21976260 . FILTER(?item != wd:Q21976260) ?item rdfs:label ?label FILTER(LANG(?label)="en") OPTIONAL { ?item skos:altLabel ?alt FILTER(LANG(?alt)="en") } OPTIONAL { ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?links } FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?item wdt:P31 wd:Q4167410 } } GROUP BY ?item ?label ?links
